name: Yumehamihime in the Black Theater
original_name: 夢喰姫 in the Black Theater
source:
I like fairy tales about princesses. Snow White, Cinderella, Sleeping Beauty... they all have a prince charming who comes to pick them up. So I fell in love with the prince in the picture book, wishing that I were such a princess. I had no doubt that a prince would come for me one day...

But I am not Snow White, Cinderella, or Sleeping Beauty. I can't be any of those princesses. No matter how much I grow, I will always be me, and princes and princesses only exist in picture books. That's what I've come to realize. 

...That's why I've been waiting for my own prince for a long time. My name is Yumehamihime. I'll be waiting for you forever in a castle deep in the mountains...
translation:
我喜欢公主的童话。白雪公主、灰姑娘、睡美人……她们都有前来迎接自己的白马王子。于是，我爱上了绘本里的王子，盼望自己也能成为那样的公主。我从未怀疑，总有一天，王子会来接我……

可我既不是白雪公主，也不是灰姑娘或睡美人。我成不了她们中的任何一位公主。无论怎样长大，我始终只是我，王子和公主只存在于绘本里。我渐渐明白了这一点。

……所以，我一直在等待属于自己的王子。我的名字叫梦喰姬。我会在深山里的城堡中，永远等着你……
